draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.43, the 14th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 1st of 31 at WR. He lasted until pick 39, well after his grade rank (14th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Garrett Wilson. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 676 receiving yards in 2024, 21st of 31 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Chicago Bears. 15 career games and 5 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 6 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: catch rate 78.3% (98th percentile), yards per target 10.9 (95th percentile), yards after catch per reception 7.1 (94th percentile). Weak spots: drop rate 6.7% (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 wide receiver who played: 652 receiving yards against a median of 198, above the norm.
